feat(providers): verify OpenCode 1.18.31 for the deny-all policy (#575)

* feat(providers): verify OpenCode 1.18.31 for the deny-all policy

- Bump _OPENCODE_SUPPORTED_VERSION 1.18.30 → 1.18.31 plus all version
  references (code comments, test fixtures, README pin note, DEVELOPMENT);
  run --help flags identical across the bump, no policy changes
- Fix test_probe_rejects_unverified_version to use 1.18.99 as its
  rejection case (it had hardcoded the new pinned version)
- Verified: provider suites 128 passed; ruff + format clean; live
  self-scan on 1.18.31 via Zen free tier (opencode/mimo-v2.5-free):
  llm_available true, 3/3 calls succeeded, 0 semantic findings

Signed-off-by: Yoseph Zuskin <zuskinyoseph@gmail.com>
Co-Authored-By: OpenCode Muse Spark 1.3 Free (1M context) <noreply@opencode.ai>

* test(providers): use a version outside both pins in deny-all test

- test_unverified_runtime_version_fails_before_inference faked 1.18.31
  as its rejection case, which stopped failing once the pin bumped to
  it (CI: DID NOT RAISE); fake 1.18.99 instead, wrong under both pins

Signed-off-by: Yoseph Zuskin <zuskinyoseph@gmail.com>
Co-Authored-By: OpenCode Muse Spark 1.3 Free (1M context) <noreply@opencode.ai>
